why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, one per expect line: "Check 1" compares --tsv output with CSV output, and "Check 2" greps README.md. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition mentions npm test or the CSV tests. Check 1 passes when the --tsv array equals the CSV array, and Check 2 passes when README mentions --tsv for tab-separated input. The brief also runs npm test and checks that the no-flag output hasn't changed, but only in a separate section labelled "Advisory (does not affect PASS or FAIL)". That keeps it from being a third check. The builder brief asks for npm test, but the must_not items only apply to the verifier's checks. Neither item is violated.
